pr_title: eth: fix shutdown regression to abort downloads, not just cancel
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/issues/20975

I still managed to hang it once, but not general, so there might be something still in there, but at least most hangs are fixed.

issue_context.title: `eth` hangs on shutdown if blocks are importing

https://gist.github.com/karalabe/6a70301a0018a3b52cfc7f5a0c17e0dc

This seems to be a regression from https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/20695
